class.name: HierarchySystem
class.brief_description: Backend for entity structural relationships and transform inheritance.
class.description: [HierarchySystem] is the structural backbone that implements "Parent-Child" relationships within the ECS world. While the [EntityManager] stores flat data, the [HierarchySystem] maintains the logical graph that determines how transforms are inherited. It is designed for [b]SIMD-accelerated Hierarchies[/b]. When a parent moves, the system calculates the world transforms for all its descendants in a single parallel pass, using a optimized "Top-Down" sorting strategy to minimize cache misses. [b]Features:[/b] - [b]Depth-First Execution:[/b] Guaranteed order of updates (parents always process before children). - [b]2D and 3D Support:[/b] Unified management for both spatial dimensions. - [b]Hierarchy Validation:[/b] Built-in checks for circular dependencies—which are logically impossible in this data-oriented model but checked for hardening. [b]Note:[/b] Creating deep hierarchies (hundreds of levels) is supported but should be used sparingly for performance optimization.

method.name: set_parent
method.description: Links the [param child] entity to the [param parent]. The child will now inherit the parent's global transformation. Setting [param parent] to [code]0[/code] will detach the child, making it a root-level entity.

method.name: fix_all_depths
method.description: Rescans the entire entity population to recalculate hierarchy depths. This is automatically called when entities are parented/unparented. Manual calls can be used after a massive save-game load to ensure the update graph is perfectly optimized.

method.name: validate_hierarchy_integrity
method.description: Deep-audits the world registry for circular parenting. Returns [code]true[/code] if the world is structurally sound.
